correctness.rationale: The joint-moment recursions condition on the index used for the current affine update before transitioning to the next index. Their homogeneous diagonal blocks have column norms at most 1/2 and 1/4, and the block-triangular affine recursion converges for independent square-integrable starts. Independently, encode the state by σ=±1 with E[σ_next|σ]=ρσ and write the update as (−1/8−3σ/8)x+σ. At stationarity the first-moment sum and contrast satisfy E[x]=−ρ/3 and E[σx]=ρ. For M=E[x²] and N=E[σx²], expansion then gives 27M−3N=32 and (32−5ρ)N−3ρM=−64ρ²/3. Elimination yields M=(64−10ρ−4ρ²)/[9(6−ρ)], the stated rational function. Factoring the difference from M(0) gives the two zeros and all signs; differentiation gives the sole interior maximum at 6−√35. The endpoint values are limits under the stated sampler domain. Continuity of the fixed point, and of the full-objective minimizer, preserves the strict comparisons at the three specified correlations under sufficiently small perturbations, not an unchanged numerical threshold. Read the supplied symbolic and rational checker; the proof, not the finite path tests, establishes the continuum claim.
